title: Lice
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office faces a lice outbreak that spreads among several employees, prompting Dwight to enforce strict quarantine measures. Pam struggles with the revelation that her daughter Cece has lice and the possibility that she brought it into the office, while Meredith copes by shaving her head. Meanwhile, Darryl and Val amicably break up but later reconcile, and Jim deals with a painful lip injury alongside work and family pressures. The office tries natural remedies like mayonnaise to combat the lice, and tensions rise as coworkers react to the situation, but the ultimate resolution of the outbreak and some personal outcomes remain uncertain.
